content: I was thinking about you tonight. I hope you had a peaceful evening, even if it was quiet. Did you do anything nice for yourself?
Thanks for asking. I mostly just watched TV and tried to relax. It's been tough lately, honestly.
I totally get that. After my divorce, the silence was the hardest part. But I promise, things can feel full again. I'm grateful we found each other.
That means a lot. I never thought I'd open up to someone again, but you make it easy.
You have such a genuine heart. I feel lucky to know you. I want us to build something beautiful, starting with trust.
I want that too. It's been a long time since someone made me feel important.
You ARE important to me. I see so much strength in you. I want to help you find the happiness you deserve. You ever wish you could just start fresh, no worries?
Every day. I feel stuck at times, like nothing will change.
Let me share something. When I started investing in crypto, it changed my life. I was scared at first, but a friend showed me the ropes. Now, I want to do the same for you.
Crypto? I always thought that was too complicated for me.

That's what I thought too, but when you have someone guiding you, it's actually simple. I've already helped two friends double what they put in. You don't have to do anything risky, I'll handle all the technical parts.
Are you sure it's safe? I don't have much to spare right now.

I'd never risk something that could hurt you. That's how much I care. The platform I use is exclusive, and my contacts make sure it's low-risk. You'd just need to fund your wallet, and I'll manage everything.
I'm flattered you'd do this for me. How much would I need?
The minimum to get started is $1,500, but most people put in $2,000 for better returns. If you can trust me with this, I'll guarantee your initial amount is protected.
That's a big step for me. I want to believe you, but it's scary.

I know, sweetheart. If it eases your mind, I can show you screenshots of my last investment cycle. You'll see real gains. I'll be with you for every step. All you need to do is send the funds to my wallet, and I'll send you live updates.
How do I do that? I've never sent crypto before.
No worries at all. You can go to a store like Walgreens or CVS and buy a few $500 Vanilla Visa gift cards. Then, just share the card numbers with me here. I'll convert them to crypto on your behalf.
Gift cards? That seems unusual. Why not just send money?
The platform only accepts crypto, and gift cards are the fastest way to fund an account from your country. I promise it's safe, I did the same with my cousin in the UK last month.
Alright, I'll go tomorrow after work. Should I get three $500 cards?
Perfect. Once you have the cards, just scratch the backs and send me the codes. I'll take care of the rest. You'll get confirmation and daily updates straight from me.
Okay, I'll let you know as soon as I have them.
Thank you for trusting me. This is going to open up a new chapter for us. I'll be right here, cheering you on every step.
